mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: BMW E90 forum thread telling other builders to measure every King bearing before fitting it. An explicit buyer-warning aimed at the whole brand rather than one part number, on a large BMW community.

mentions.title: Just call it what it is - King Bearings are no longer an option
mentions.snippet: DSM community thread arguing King is no longer a viable choice for 6-bolt engines because orders have sat on back-order since the pandemic. An availability and supply complaint rather than a defect, but it is a builder publicly writing King off.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Builder found King STDX thrust bearings over 1mm too narrow to fit both S85 and S65 blocks, and concluded King main bearings cannot be trusted for those engines. A measurable fitment defect on King's largest engine family by revenue.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Diesel Truck Forum buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings. Search results indicate the free-spread spec was out of tolerance on 2024 stock and that 2024 and 2025 production runs showed the same problem, so this reads as recurring rather than a one-off batch.

mentions.title: King Bearings?
mentions.snippet: Builders report inconsistent shell thickness, excessive crush, and dents in the steel backs of King aluminum bearings present before unpacking. Other posters in the thread defend the product.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: A customer received the wrong size assortment in a sealed King XP package and could not get help directly from King, who routed them back to the supplier. The service failure is the substance of the complaint, separate from the packing error.
